visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with vibrant pink hair, wearing a white oversized T-shirt, grey shorts, and white clogs with black socks, stands in a plain room with white walls and a grey tiled floor. He holds a small circular grey Momax speaker toward the camera lens, demonstrating its compact design and size while gesturing with his other hand which holds a black smartphone. (2) The camera remains static as the man performs an energetic dance routine, swinging his arms and legs rhythmically to an unseen beat. The lighting is bright and uniform, reflecting off the clean white wall behind him. The environment is sparse, resembling a simple studio or a corner of an office. (3) The scene cuts to a second man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black T-shirt and black shorts. He stands in front of a large whiteboard filled with handwritten Traditional Chinese text, product specifications, and dates. He holds the same grey speaker, points to various sections of the whiteboard, and then transitions into a dance routine. (4) Both men appear together in a larger room containing a long wooden conference table and the same whiteboard. They demonstrate the speaker's magnetic properties by sticking it directly onto the white metal board. They gesture toward the camera with thumbs-up signs and smiles, highlighting the promotional dates written on the board. (5) A rapid-fire montage follows, showing clips of both men dancing individually and together in front of the whiteboard. Brightly colored text overlays with black backgrounds frequently pop up on the screen, detailing product features like '360-degree sound' and pricing information. The camera angle remains mostly at eye-level throughout these sequences.

It effectively showcases technical features like 360-degree sound, magnetic mounting, and IPX6 waterproofing while creating a sense of urgency with a specific 'group buy' discount price and limited-time offer.
